Abstract

Let x be the Boolean function. We prove that its exact quantum query complexity is y.

1 Introduction

The exact quantum query complexity measures the minimum number of oracle calls. Prior work left the three-query question open.

2 Main Theorem

We construct a rational dual certificate showing no three-query algorithm exists.

3 Conclusion

The exact query complexity is four. This closes the open problem.
